high_level_description: The image is a black-and-white woodcut illustration depicting a scene from the night of November 12, 1833, when a meteor shower was observed. The text at the top of the image provides historical context, noting that during this event, it was possible to see up to 100,000 meteors crossing the sky every hour. It also mentions that many people at the time believed it was the end of the world, which inspired the artwork.
